Left Right

### How Omega-3 Free Fatty Acids Improve Absorption

AvailOm^{®} from Evonik delivers EPA and DHA as free fatty acids in a solid omega-3 lysine complex,
the form that is absorbed most efficiently.
[Read Article][123]

### The Role of Potassium Iodide as a Dietary Supplement

Potassium iodide (KI) is one of the most widely used and bioavailable forms of iodine
supplementation, providing a safe and reliable source of iodine ions for a wide range of nutritional
applications.
[Read Article][124]

### Bostik PURELAM™ and PURETHANE™ Laminating Adhesives

Bostik PURELAM™ and PURETHANE™ laminating adhesives deliver fast cure, high line speeds, and
reliable performance for flexible packaging applications.
[Read Article][125]

### Lubrication Troubleshooting Playbook: Symptoms, Causes, and Fixes

Sourcing is not just about getting lubricants in stock. It is about helping maintenance standardize
the use of the right lubricant for the operating conditions, material set, failure mode, and
maintenance interval.
[Read Article][126]

### What Is N,N-Dimethylacetoacetamide (DMAA)?

What is DMAA? Learn how N,N-dimethylacetoacetamide functions as a resin copromoter and chemical
intermediate for coatings, polymers, and synthesis.
[Read Article][127]

### Application Lab Testing for Camlin Fine Sciences Antioxidants

Camlin Fine Sciences (CFS) operates a dedicated Customer Application Lab staffed with technical
experts who evaluate, validate, and fine-tune antioxidant performance in your system.
[Read Article][128]

### Eastman - Role of Triethyl Phosphate in PVC

Discover how triethyl phosphate enhances PVC flexibility and fire resistance as a co-plasticizer and
flame-retardant. Request an Eastman TEP sample today!
[Read Article][129]

### DOWFROST™ LC for Data Center Liquid Cooling

DOWFROST™ LC is an inhibited propylene glycol-based heat transfer fluid designed specifically for
liquid cooling systems where thermal performance, corrosion protection, freeze protection, and
system compatibility are critical. Its primary applications in data center environments are
Direct-to-Chip cooling and support for in-rack closed-loop and in-row close-coupled cooling systems.
[Read Article][130]

Previous Next
LyondellBasell reports first quarter 2026 earnings

LyondellBasell Industries (NYSE: LYB) (the "company") announced results for the first quarter 2026.
The company reported net income for the first quarter 2026 of $125 million, or $0.38 per diluted
share. During the quarter, the company recognized $38 million of identified items, net of tax. These
items, which impacted first quarter earnings by $0.11 per share, included non-cash asset
write-downs, costs incurred for transactions and discontinued operations. First quarter 2026 EBITDA
was $568 million, or $615 million excluding identified items.

[

Read more

][2]
[Employees and industrial infrastructure representing LyondellBasell’s commitment to sustainability
and responsible operations.]
2025 sustainability report

LyondellBasell (LYB) is a leader in the global chemical industry creating solutions for everyday
sustainable living. Through advanced technology and focused investments, we are working to enable a
circular and low carbon economy. Across all we do, we aim to unlock value for our customers,
investors and society. Our sustainability approach is organized around three interconnected
elements: building on strong foundations, unlocking change and pioneering transformative solutions.

[

Read more

][3]
2025 Annual Report: CEO letter

2025 challenged the entire chemical industry as we navigated what remains one of the longest
downturns on record. Against this backdrop, LYB made deliberate business and financial decisions to
preserve and grow value through the cycle and position the company for long-term success.

[

Read more

][4]

## Element proof – Winter with LYB

Winter brings two sides of everyday life – adventure in the elements and safety at home. LYB
materials make both everyday edge and everyday comfort possible, enabling performance and protection
all season long.

[ Read more ][5]

## GPCA Annual Forum: CEO discusses LYB transformation

CEO Peter Vanacker spoke at the 19th edition of the Gulf Petrochemicals and Chemicals Association
(GPCA) Annual Forum held in Manama, Bahrain, Dec. 8-11. 

[

Read more

][6]

## Purell medical grade polymers expand in North America

The *Purell* portfolio is available in North America. This move represents more than portfolio
expansion — it marks a strategic shift in how LYB supports one of the world’s fastest-growing
healthcare markets.

[ Learn more ][7]

## Henkel and LyondellBasell collaborate on bio-circular raw material solution

LYB and Henkel have partnered to create a renewable-based transparent plastic cage for Henkel’s WC
Frisch/Bref solid toilet rim blocks. Made through injection molding, the cage contains 30%
mechanically recycled plastics and 70% bio-circular raw materials from LYB CirculenRenew portfolio
using a mass balance approach. The collaboration highlights both companies’ commitment to
sustainable packaging innovation.

[ Learn more ][8]

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

## Our Industries

* [ [Mass]Mass Transportation ][175]
* [ [Packaging]Packaging ][176]

[OUR INDUSTRIES][177]

[A man holding looking at a tablet screen with a chart]

## Products

We gain insights by understanding our customers’ needs and use our technical expertise to tailor
solutions to help maximize their market advantage moving forward.

[OUR PRODUCTS][178]

## Sustainability

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the
megatrends that will impact on our lives in the years to come.

[LATEST SUSTAINABILITY REPORTING][179]
[Two]

## Investors

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,
learning and operational excellence.

[INVESTORS][180]

## CAREERS

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference
both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

[VIEW JOB OPPORTUNITIES][181]
[Three people looking at a whiteboard]
[
][182]

## Our Brand

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct
to collaborate. Together we're making Chemistry that Matters™.

[Our Brand][183]

## Our Stories

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are
making a meaningful impact in the world and delivering Chemistry that Matters™.

[Read our stories][184]

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

## Products

We gain insights by understanding our customers’ needs and use our technical expertise to tailor
solutions to help maximize their market advantage moving forward.

## Sustainability

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the
megatrends that will impact on our lives in the years to come.

## Investors

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,
learning and operational excellence.

## CAREERS

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference
both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

## Our Brand

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct
to collaborate. Together we're making Chemistry that Matters™.

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are
making a meaningful impact in the world and delivering Chemistry that Matters™.

## A Leader in Distributing Industrial and Specialty Chemicals

A.G. Layne is a leading chemical distribution company in Los Angeles, well known for linking our
country’s top high purity chemicals including lubricants, silicone fluids, industrial solvents and
specialty chemical manufacturers to the companies who make the everyday products consumers buy
across America. We make it our mission to safely blend, package, and transport these important
building blocks to the complete satisfaction of our customers.

Count on A.G. Layne for:
* Blending
* Bulk Tank Trucks
* Custom Formulating
* [Delivery][74]
* [Packaging][75]
* Plant Surveys
* Portable Tote Bins
* Private Labeling

## Raising the bar with more services

A.G. Layne is committed to delivering what our customers need to compete in the ever-changing
marketplace. We offer a wide variety of [high purity chemicals][76], lubricants, [plasticizers][77],
[recycled solvents][78], [silicone fluids][79], [military spec solvents][80] as well as [specialty
blends][81]. Customers also take advantage of our expanded services, which include:
* Packaging in small pack sizes and bulk—1-gallon bottles, 5-gallon pails, drums, IBCs and bulk tank
  trucks
* Tank truck quantities; IBCs; drums; pails; cases of one-gallon bottles
* Private labeling for production efficiency
* Compliant products for paint and coatings, printing, and metal finishing industries
* Plant Product Surveys
* Plant Safety Surveys
* Custom blending and specialty formulations

**Innovative "in house" formulations that include:**
* Brake Cleaners
* Graphic Arts Blends
* Lacquer Thinners
* Nail Polish Removers & Thinners
* VOC Compliant Blanket & Roller Washes; Ink Removers; MRC Blends; Solvent Cleaners, and Solvent
  Degreasers

## Ensuring import/Export quality with world-class sources

As your global chemical distribution company in Los Angeles, A.G. Layne makes sure your company has
dependable access to the highest quality products, state-of-the-art refineries and suppliers from
around the world including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and the Middle East.

In addition to sourcing industrial solvents and chemicals from preferred locally and globally
recognized suppliers, you can depend on competitive costs and several warehousing options combined
with our well-known service that focuses on your particular business needs.

## rail keeps outstanding Efficiency on track

Railway transportation is still considered the safest and most efficient for high volume freight.
That’s why A.G. Layne features its own fleet of [rail][82] cars, which are also available to
customers who want to save and get reliable secure shipping or storage.

What’s more, we ensure that superior products come from only world-class suppliers

Questions? We have answersNeed help?
Is Airlift a freight forwarder or an NVOCC

We are both. Airlift is a licensed NVOCC and global freight forwarder. As an NVOCC, we issue our own
house bills of lading, negotiate directly with carriers, and operate with more control over space
and routing. As a forwarder, we manage the entire logistics chain, including documentation, customs,
and trucking — delivering a complete, tech-enabled solution.

How does Airlift help me ship globally?

We have operational hubs in India, Vietnam, the USA, and Canada. Beyond these, our vetted agent
network spans South & Southeast Asia and other key trade lanes in Europe and the Middle East —
giving you true global reach.

* Each valid PO is added to ISA, providing accurate POD.

* Every driver is carefully vetted and fully certified.
* All vehicles have high-value insurance, with optional additional coverage.
* Full GPS tracking with periodic real-time photo updates.
* Multiple emergency plans in place for all routes.

chemical analysis, essential in the petrochemical and energy sectors for accurate composition
identification and property analysis.
Flow Assurance and Pipeline Integrity

blockages, hydrate formations, and scale buildup, ensuring smooth pipeline operations. Additionally,
our Pipeline Integrity Testing covers corrosion, fluid dynamics, and mechanical assessments, vital
for maintaining safe and efficient pipeline infrastructure.

We offer Material and Fluid Compatibility Tests, along with Corrosion Testing and Reservoir

# Raw Materials Supplier USA

Bisley International deploys a holistic understanding of markets, technical insight and logistics
excellence to build durable strategies which unite the world’s best raw material producers with
industrial consumers in North America. We supply and distribute a wide range of specialty chemicals,
minerals, raw materials and more...

[About Us][55] [View Products][56]

WHAT WE DO

## Industry experts & the trusted chemical raw material supplier in the USA & Worldwide

Established in Houston, Texas, USA, Bisley International draws on the global reach of the
multinational Bisley Group, with 65 years of experience in marketing and as distributor of chemical
products and high quality industrial raw materials throughout Asia Pacific, Oceania and the Middle
East.

[Contact Sales][57] [Visit Bisley Group Australia][58]

As international raw materials and chemical suppliers, our products range from Fine Industrial
Chemicals for highly specialised applications, to bulk raw materials delivered in shiploads to major
regional manufacturers.

Our goal is to provide a complete package of technically outstanding products, supported by
proficient, responsive staff and first class logistics to a range of industries.

**Our Value Proposition**
We pride ourselves in our ability to add value and create synergies for our supplier and customer
partners.

**Our Guarantees**
We believe it’s important to focus on what is most valuable to our customers and really stand by
this - for the long term.

**Our strategic network…**
Our experienced team of logistics experts are able to track our cargo movements from factories
across the globe right to our customer’s doorstep, whilst keeping all stakeholders informed with up
to date information.

Bisley International is supported by the Bisley Group, with headquarters in Sydney, Australia.
Global chemical sourcing is also supported through our network of offices in the UAE, Bangkok,
Singapore, Malaysia, New Zealand, Indonesia and USA.

# Raw Materials Supplier USA

Bisley International deploys a holistic understanding of markets, technical insight and logistics
excellence to build durable strategies which unite the world’s best raw material producers with
industrial consumers in North America. We supply and distribute a wide range of specialty chemicals,
minerals, raw materials and more...

[About Us][55] [View Products][56]

WHAT WE DO

## Industry experts & the trusted chemical raw material supplier in the USA & Worldwide

Established in Houston, Texas, USA, Bisley International draws on the global reach of the
multinational Bisley Group, with 65 years of experience in marketing and as distributor of chemical
products and high quality industrial raw materials throughout Asia Pacific, Oceania and the Middle
East.

[Contact Sales][57] [Visit Bisley Group Australia][58]

As international raw materials and chemical suppliers, our products range from Fine Industrial
Chemicals for highly specialised applications, to bulk raw materials delivered in shiploads to major
regional manufacturers.

Our goal is to provide a complete package of technically outstanding products, supported by
proficient, responsive staff and first class logistics to a range of industries.

**Our Value Proposition**
We pride ourselves in our ability to add value and create synergies for our supplier and customer
partners.

**Our Guarantees**
We believe it’s important to focus on what is most valuable to our customers and really stand by
this - for the long term.

**Our strategic network…**
Our experienced team of logistics experts are able to track our cargo movements from factories
across the globe right to our customer’s doorstep, whilst keeping all stakeholders informed with up
to date information.

Bisley International is supported by the Bisley Group, with headquarters in Sydney, Australia.
Global chemical sourcing is also supported through our network of offices in the UAE, Bangkok,
Singapore, Malaysia, New Zealand, Indonesia and USA.

A member-owned alliance of top-tier distributors, connecting industries, sourcing solutions, and

[ BECOME A SUPPLIER ][28]

# WHO WE ARE

The Chemical Distribution Network is a collaborative network of independent chemical distributors
committed to safety, quality, and service excellence. United by a shared mission, our members serve
critical industries across North America, providing innovative solutions and localized expertise.

[Top 100 Chemical Distributors]

###### [MORE ABOUT US][30]

##### Our Members

[ [Astro-Chemicals-Inc-logo] ][31]
[ [Barsol Solvents and Chemicals] ][32]
[ [Brown-Chemical-Co-Inc-logo] ][33]
[ [Buckley-Oil-logo] ][34]
[ [ChemGroup-logo] ][35]
[ [Colonial Chemical Solutions, Inc.] ][36]
[ [JRHessCompanyIncHeader_BottomAlignment@2x] ][37]
[ [Lowe Chemical Company] ][38]
[ [NomanFox Logo] ][39]
[ [Producers Chemical Company] ][40]
[ [Logo - Riteks] ][41]
[ [Seeler Industries Incorporated] ][42]
[ [Whitaker Logo] ][43]
[ [Viking Chemical Company] ][44]
[ [Webb Chemical Service Corporation] ][45]

## WHAT WE DO

We unite leading privately held chemical distributors who collaborate to create smarter solutions,
stronger partnerships, and a safer, more efficient industry.

###### SOURCING

Through shared programs and aggregated spend, we deliver cost savings and supply stability to our
members.

###### DISTRIBUTION SERVICES

We help members expand their reach with reliable partners and industry-leading safety and compliance
standards.

###### MEMBER COLLABORATION

Our members collaborate to exchange insights, share best practices, and identify new growth
opportunities.

[Chemical Storage Terminal]

###### GLOBAL IMPORTS

We simplify global sourcing, connecting members to trusted suppliers and efficient import pathways.

## CONNECTED FOR GROWTH

##### Membership Benefits

A unified network means you get more negotiating power, better market visibility, and a louder voice
on issues that matter most to your industry. Plus, you’ll enjoy benefits like expanded access,
shared expertise, and game-changing programs that make doing business easier and more rewarding.

[Chemical Transport Truck Fleet]
* Collective Purchasing Power & Supplier Programs
* A Trusted Peer Network
* Support for Next-Generation Leaders
* CDN Imports
* Knowledge Exchange & Best Practices
* Inter-Member Buying & Selling Opportunities
* Expanded Capabilities & Distribution Reach
* Member Collaboration & Distribution Events
* Programming Designed for Independent Distributors
* A Tangible Return on Investment

## CONNECT. COLLABORATE.
## COMPETE STRONGER.

Learn more about CDN membership

[ MEMBER BENEFITS ][46]
[Chemical Industry Image Collage]

## 15,000+

Customers

## 45+

Distribution Facilities
to Service Your Needs

## 5th

## MEMBER QUOTES

The Chemical Distribution Network gives Barton Solvents strength beyond our size… it helps us
deliver more to our customers, build strong supplier partnerships and stay agile in a rapidly
changing market.
– Shawn Samples, Vice President Sales
[Barsol Solvents and Chemicals]
Buckley Oil is thrilled to be a member of CDN and embrace the opportunities this partnership brings.
This affiliation aligns with our values and provides us with the chance to learn, grow, and
contribute to a stronger, more connected industry. Together, we can tackle challenges, create new
opportunities, and drive success.
– Robert Rice, President
[Buckley-Oil-logo]
Strong relationships are the foundation of lasting success. Chemical Distribution Network doesn’t
just connect independent distributors — it empowers us
– Colie Whitaker, President
[Whitaker Logo]
CDN is proof that when independent distributors unite, we amplify our ability to deliver. Our shared
expertise, supplier access, and commitment to integrity allow members to compete stronger, grow
faster, and serve customers better. It is a member-driven network that keeps collaboration and
customer value at its core.
– Andrew Tuttle, Chief Operating Officer & Chairman of the Board, CDN
[Viking Chemical Company]

## TAP INTO THE POWER OF THE NETWORK.

[ChemGroup]
**Infrastructure**
ChemGroup is a leading distributor of industrial and specialty chemicals which is among the nation's
largest, ranking in the top 25 in North America and top 100 globally. As a super-regional
distributor, ChemGroup operates a vast array of truck, barge, and rail terminals, and has numerous
chemical distribution facilities throughout the US.

Markets served include: Ohio, Indiana, Tennessee, Kentucky, Georgia, Alabama, Virginia, W. Virginia,
Michigan, Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, Illinois, North Carolina, South Carolina, Mississippi, Missouri.
Customers also in New York, Florida and Texas.

ChemGroup Operating Companies include:
* Bonded Chemicals, Inc.- Columbus, OH, Medina, OH
* Chemical Services, Inc. – Dayton, OH, Toledo, OH, Ft. Wayne, IN
* Chemicals Inc. USA – Cincinnati, OH, Indianapolis IN
* Chemical Resources, Inc. – Louisville KY
* Specialty Chemical Co. LLC – Cleveland TN, Piney Flats, TN
**Experience**
The ChemGroup was established in 1980 and is celebrating 33 years of exceeding our customers’
expectations.

The ChemGroup maintains the highest levels of industry certification available today including: ISO
9000:2008, UL, ANSI, NSF and WQA and as an active member of the National Association of Chemical
Distributors since 1996 we promote full compliance with association guidelines, standards for safety
and standardization of handling chemicals and the betterment of the Chemical Distribution industry.

**Intelligence**
The ChemGroup’s depth of market intelligence and product application experience allows us to connect
you with the right products for your needs.

Our knowledgeable sales and support teams service customers in nearly all major industrial market
segments today including: Water, Paper & Waste Treatment, Chemical Compounding and Processing,
Metalworking, Metal Plating and Finishing, Household Industrial and & Institutional cleaning,
Agrochemicals, Oil and Gas, Mining, Food, Personal Care, Paint & Coatings, Inks and Pigments,
Adhesives, Elastomers, Sealants, Pharmaceutical, Leather and Textiles, Automotive, Appliance,
Electronics & Construction.

**Support**
The ChemGroup offers world-class infrastructure coupled with service, care and knowledge of local
distribution. Our supply chain and inventory management, state of the art facilities, local market
intelligence, "24/7" Services, 98+% on-time delivery, well maintained fleet, superior safety record,
ISO, UL and NSF certifications afford us the flexibility to customize delivery packaging and
material handling solutions to support your business objectives.
**Commitment**
ChemGroup is a privately held American company conceived in the spirit of entrepreneurialism and
anchored by core values of integrity, customer service, teamwork, motivation, leadership,
professionalism and innovation.

Our purpose and mission depends on helping our customers and suppliers succeed in theirs and our
culture is rooted in our commitment to safety, quality and social responsibility

# Great partnerships begin with chemistry

## Chemtrade

Like elements acting in **partnership** to create the **chemical products** we sell, Chemtrade is
strengthened by the many people, groups and organizations we are fortunate to call partners.

We are driven by a clear Vision: **create value through responsible chemistry**. The three pillars
of Chemtrade’s Values – Safety, Excellence, and Partnership – shape everything we do, empowering our
people to serve customers with quality products and services across North America and around the
world.

Chemtrade is connections.

## Chemical Products

We operate in two strategic business segments, each featuring a lineup of high-quality industrial
chemical products.

Agriculture, and more.

* [Responsible care img in Environmental, Social & Governance] *

### A promise to the planet

Chemtrade is committed to doing business in a responsible manner. Sustainability and safety are core
values woven into every aspect of our business from manufacturing to shipping, employee training,
and more. The commitment we make to offering a safe workplace and operating in a sustainable manner
extends through every level of our company.

Responsible Care®, the chemical industry’s voluntary, comprehensive initiative in safe, responsible,
and sustainable chemical manufacturing, is the heart of Chemtrade’s commitment to Environmental,
Social & Governance practices. It is a key element of our partnerships with the people who work
here, the customers and suppliers we do business with, and the communities we operate in.

Find out more about Chemtrade’s Commitment to [Environmental, Social & Governance practices and
Responsible Care®.][94]

# Great partnerships begin with chemistry

## Chemtrade

Like elements acting in **partnership** to create the **chemical products** we sell, Chemtrade is
strengthened by the many people, groups and organizations we are fortunate to call partners.

We are driven by a clear Vision: **create value through responsible chemistry**. The three pillars
of Chemtrade’s Values – Safety, Excellence, and Partnership – shape everything we do, empowering our
people to serve customers with quality products and services across North America and around the
world.

Chemtrade is connections.

## Chemical Products

We operate in two strategic business segments, each featuring a lineup of high-quality industrial
chemical products.

## Environmental, Social & Governance

* [Responsible care img in Environmental, Social & Governance] *

### A promise to the planet

Chemtrade is committed to doing business in a responsible manner. Sustainability and safety are core
values woven into every aspect of our business from manufacturing to shipping, employee training,
and more. The commitment we make to offering a safe workplace and operating in a sustainable manner
extends through every level of our company.

Responsible Care®, the chemical industry’s voluntary, comprehensive initiative in safe, responsible,
and sustainable chemical manufacturing, is the heart of Chemtrade’s commitment to Environmental,
Social & Governance practices. It is a key element of our partnerships with the people who work
here, the customers and suppliers we do business with, and the communities we operate in.

Find out more about Chemtrade’s Commitment to [Environmental, Social & Governance practices and

# Commodity Trading

Intro to Commodities, How They are Traded, and What Drives Prices
Written by [Frank Moraes][199]·Updated April 17, 2026·Cited by Forbes, The Guardian, Stanford
University [+48+ more][200]

Commodities are the raw building blocks of the world economy. From oil and corn to gold and lithium,
they trade in vast, liquid markets where price – not provenance – matters most.

## Why commodities matter

Producers hedge. Traders speculate. Consumers – from airlines to bakeries – lock in costs. Learning
how these markets work helps investors ride cycles and avoid hype.

**Quick fact:** In 2024 futures contracts worth *US $28 trn* changed hands on the CME alone.

## Major categories

Most commodities fall into four baskets:
* **Agriculture** – corn, coffee, wheat
* **Energy** – crude oil, natural gas, gasoline
* **Metals** – gold, copper, aluminium
* **Environmental & Emerging** – carbon credits, cryptocurrencies

### Agricultural highlights

Corn feeds livestock and, increasingly, cars. Coffee supplies hinge on a handful of tropical
producers. Wheat still provides a fifth of the planet’s calories.

Only **five** countries grow two‑thirds of the world’s coffee. Weather in Brazil can jolt global
prices overnight.

### Energy movers

Oil remains the economy’s lifeblood, but gas is the swing fuel for power grids. Traders watch US
shale rig counts, OPEC quotas and LNG cargo flows.

### Metals in demand

Gold is insurance against turmoil, copper the wiring of the energy transition. Prices move with real
rates, construction data and Chinese demand.

### Cryptocurrencies

[Bitcoin][229], Ethereum and their peers trade like digital commodities – scarce, fungible and prone
to booms and busts.

## What moves prices?
* **Growth:** Rising GDP means more steel, beef and fuel.
* **Dollar strength:** Commodities are priced in greenbacks; a stronger dollar often pushes prices
  down.
* **Substitution:** High sugar prices spur demand for corn syrup.
* **Weather & shocks:** Droughts lift grain prices; wars disrupt energy flows.

## How to gain exposure
1. **Physical ownership:** bullion or delivered barrels (rare for retail traders).
2. **Equities/Bonds:** buy miners, drillers or processors.
3. **Futures & options:** highly leveraged options.
4. **ETFs & ETCs:** one‑click baskets of futures or stored metals.
5. **[CFDs][230]:** leveraged derivatives that track commodity prices, without owning the underlying
   asset.
6. **[Prediction Markets][231]:** trade the probability of real-world events that can move commodity
   prices via platforms like [Plus500 Futures][232].

**IMPORTANT:** CFDs are not available in the USA.

# Commodity Trading

Intro to Commodities, How They are Traded, and What Drives Prices
Written by [Frank Moraes][199]·Updated April 17, 2026·Cited by Forbes, The Guardian, Stanford
University [+48+ more][200]

Commodities are the raw building blocks of the world economy. From oil and corn to gold and lithium,
they trade in vast, liquid markets where price – not provenance – matters most.

## Why commodities matter

Producers hedge. Traders speculate. Consumers – from airlines to bakeries – lock in costs. Learning
how these markets work helps investors ride cycles and avoid hype.

**Quick fact:** In 2024 futures contracts worth *US $28 trn* changed hands on the CME alone.

## Major categories

Most commodities fall into four baskets:
* **Agriculture** – corn, coffee, wheat
* **Energy** – crude oil, natural gas, gasoline
* **Metals** – gold, copper, aluminium
* **Environmental & Emerging** – carbon credits, cryptocurrencies

### Agricultural highlights

Corn feeds livestock and, increasingly, cars. Coffee supplies hinge on a handful of tropical
producers. Wheat still provides a fifth of the planet’s calories.

Only **five** countries grow two‑thirds of the world’s coffee. Weather in Brazil can jolt global
prices overnight.

### Energy movers

Oil remains the economy’s lifeblood, but gas is the swing fuel for power grids. Traders watch US
shale rig counts, OPEC quotas and LNG cargo flows.

### Metals in demand

Gold is insurance against turmoil, copper the wiring of the energy transition. Prices move with real
rates, construction data and Chinese demand.

### Cryptocurrencies

[Bitcoin][229], Ethereum and their peers trade like digital commodities – scarce, fungible and prone
to booms and busts.

## What moves prices?
* **Growth:** Rising GDP means more steel, beef and fuel.
* **Dollar strength:** Commodities are priced in greenbacks; a stronger dollar often pushes prices
  down.
* **Substitution:** High sugar prices spur demand for corn syrup.
* **Weather & shocks:** Droughts lift grain prices; wars disrupt energy flows.

## How to gain exposure
1. **Physical ownership:** bullion or delivered barrels (rare for retail traders).
2. **Equities/Bonds:** buy miners, drillers or processors.
3. **Futures & options:** highly leveraged options.
4. **ETFs & ETCs:** one‑click baskets of futures or stored metals.
5. **[CFDs][230]:** leveraged derivatives that track commodity prices, without owning the underlying
   asset.
6. **[Prediction Markets][231]:** trade the probability of real-world events that can move commodity
   prices via platforms like [Plus500 Futures][232].

**IMPORTANT:** CFDs are not available in the USA.

**Turning technology into “Technology for Life”**

Dräger manufactures medical and safety technology products. In so doing, we protect, support, and
save people's lives around the world in hospitals, with fire departments, emergency services,
authorities, and in mining as well as industry. Founded in Lübeck in 1889, Dräger has grown into a
worldwide, listed enterprise in its fifth generation as a family-run business. Dräger has more than
16,000 employees worldwide and is present in over 190 countries around the globe. In 2023, the
company generated net sales of around EUR 3.4 billion.

and service companies directly on location where our customers are.

Dräger manufactures medical and safety technology products. In so doing, we protect, support, and
save people's lives around the world in hospitals, with fire departments, emergency services,
authorities, and in mining as well as industry. Founded in Lübeck in 1889, Dräger has grown into a
worldwide, listed enterprise in its fifth generation as a family-run business. Dräger has more than
16,000 employees worldwide and is present in over 190 countries around the globe. In 2023, the
company generated net sales of around EUR 3.4 billion.

Dräger technology is used all over the world. We operate in around 50 countries with our own sales
and service companies directly on location where our customers are.

The CRX-10iA/L Paint cobot is the perfect industrial solution for manufacturers new to robotics.
This product line includes the CRX-10iA/L Paint cobot, which precisely dispenses materials for
uniform and reliable application in the paint, liquid and powder coatings, and fiberglass

applications.

The CRX-10iA/L Paint cobot is the perfect industrial solution for manufacturers new to robotics.

Flowtek manufactures liquid filling equipment—including Flowtek Liquid Filling Systems and Flowtek

execution across North America, we bring deep experience in equipment manufacturing, process system
design, controls integration, commissioning, operator training, and preventive maintenance. From
linear liquid packaging to bulk liquid storage, mixing and batching, fluid transfer, utility
distribution, and facility buildouts—we execute with clear scope, regulatory compliance, and

mid-market M&A.]][19]

### Our expertise

[[Business to Business]][20]
Business to Business Architecture & Engineering Construction E-Commerce Economic development
agencies Education Financial services/Insurance IT/Software Healthcare Recreation Transportation

[[Industrial]][21]
Industrial Aerospace Automotive Building materials & products Chemicals Electrical components &
devices Energy Food Glass Industrial equipment Material handling Metal Oil and Gas Personal
protective equipment Pharmaceuticals Process controls & equipment Pulp and Paper Water & Wastewater

**Business-to-Business Market Researc**h
[B2B market research][22] is different – a smaller universe of difficult to access decision makers
who are subject matter experts; the need for both intelligence and insights; ever-changing
competitive dynamics. Geo Strategy Partners consultants are experts at B2B. We are business
strategists as well as market researchers. We are the *“go-to firm”* when you need a *“go-to-market
strategy.”*

**Industrial Markets**
If you were searching for a firm that can tackle your [industrial market research][23] & strategy
needs, there is a reason you found us. Most market research firms are not comfortable working in
industrial sectors because it requires an understanding of technical product applications and
experience in manufacturing or field environments. At Geo Strategy Partners, we own our own hard
hats and steel toe boots.

[[Compass]][24]

### [Where you are…][25]

Listen to your customers, discover new opportunities, and analyze the competitive landscape.

[[Gyroscope]][26]

### [Where you need to be…][27]

Strategically position your company for sustainable and profitable growth and create winning
go-to-market strategies.

[[Map]][28]

### [How you get there.][29]

Develop & execute competitive strategies to enter new markets, develop new products, grow market
share. Accelerate growth through Mergers & Acquisitions.

## About

We help our clients develop winning strategies for sustainable, profitable growth. We accomplish
this through our expertise in gathering market intelligence, our methodologies for converting this
intelligence into actionable insights, and our ability to work with our clients to turn insights
into strategy.

## Our position on climate change

In our 2024-2026 Climate Action Transition Plan (2024-2026 CATP), we reconfirmed our targets for
reducing our scope 1, 2 and 3 industrial emissions against our restated 2019 baseline, to reduce at
least 15% by the end of 2026 and at least 50% by 2035 and specified a new 25% reduction target by
the end of 2030. We are currently assessing how best to integrate EVR into our climate transition
strategy, recognising that the transition away from steelmaking coal for steel production will be
slower than thermal coal. Refer to the TCFD section of our latest Annual Report and our 2024-2026
CATP for further information.

## Our position on climate change

In our 2024-2026 Climate Action Transition Plan (2024-2026 CATP), we reconfirmed our targets for
reducing our scope 1, 2 and 3 industrial emissions against our restated 2019 baseline, to reduce at
least 15% by the end of 2026 and at least 50% by 2035 and specified a new 25% reduction target by
the end of 2030. We are currently assessing how best to integrate EVR into our climate transition
strategy, recognising that the transition away from steelmaking coal for steel production will be
slower than thermal coal. Refer to the TCFD section of our latest Annual Report and our 2024-2026
CATP for further information.

smart classrooms - audio/visual - remote learning - global classroom

## **Twenty Years of Innovation: from Silicon Valley to Historic Jacksonville, Oregon**

# **About Us**

Founded in 2002 by Silicon Valley veterans, Global Caché is an industry pioneer, providing
award-winning products that connect electronic devices to a WiFi or wired network so they can be
accessed, controlled, and automated.

Our roots may be in the residential market, but our company has expanded over the last two decades
to include the commercial and education markets by providing hardware that is easy-to-use and
integrate, expanding the reach of automation/control system providers and network-based software to
any IR, serial, or relay device. Global Cache's cloud-based IR database, Control Tower, winner of
the 2015 CEA Mark of Excellence award, is available for use from our website.

Our products are proudly based on industry standards and open systems, and include published APIs
and freely available technical support. With built-in drivers and support from many industry
partners, worldwide distribution, and a direct to dealer program, our products are preferred by
thousands of installers, integrators, and dealers.

From San Jose, California to Historic Jacksonville, Oregon, Global Caché products are proudly made
in the USA.

award-winning products that connect electronic devices to a WiFi or wired network so they can be
accessed, controlled, and automated.

to include the commercial and education markets by providing hardware that is easy-to-use and
integrate, expanding the reach of automation/control system providers and network-based software to

# The chemistry
# behind everyday life.

Hartwell Chemicals is a lean, customer-driven distributor of industrial solvents, resins, coatings,
lubricants, adhesives and specialty chemicals — built to keep North American manufacturers running.

[Request a Quote][9][See the story][10]
Scroll
Chapter 01 · Our Story

## Chemistry is everywhere. Most of the time, you don't see it.

Paints, adhesives, lubricants, cleaners, plastics — the hidden building blocks of modern life.
Hartwell exists to move those building blocks, reliably and responsibly, across North America.

[Coatings & Paints]
01 · Coatings & Paints

### Every color you see.

The resins and pigments behind the walls, cars, and skyscrapers that shape our skylines. Hartwell
delivers the raw chemistry that colors modern life.

[Explore products][11]
[Construction & Asphalt]
02 · Construction & Asphalt

### The roads that move us.

Polymers, binders, and additives that keep highways intact through winters and decades. North
America runs on chemistry — we make sure it keeps moving.

[Explore products][12]
[Lubricants & Energy]
03 · Lubricants & Energy

### Keeping the world in motion.

From oilfields to manufacturing floors, specialty lubricants protect the machinery that builds
everything else. Reliable supply, precise specs, every time.

[Explore products][13]
[Adhesives & Packaging]
04 · Adhesives & Packaging

### What holds it all together.

The quiet layer in every package, every bonded panel, every laminated surface — engineered chemistry
that disappears into the products you trust.

[Explore products][14]
[Detergents & Cleaning]
05 · Detergents & Cleaning

### Clean starts here.

Surfactants, solvents and builders that make homes, hospitals and factories hygienic. We source to
spec so formulators can focus on innovation.

[Explore products][15]
Chapter 02 · Industries we serve

## From the factory floor

News
April 8, 2026
[ MOBILedit Forensic 9.8: Advanced Bypassing & 16 Languages ][57]
April 8, 2026

**MOBILedit Forensic 9.8 is here, taking smartwatch forensics and device analysis to the next
level:** Now with expanded multi-language support — available in 16 languages. Work offline, extract
heart rate data from Samsung watches beyond recorded activities, gain full activity insights from
Garmin devices, analyze Samsung network diagnostics, unlock UNISOC and EXYNOS devices with advanced
security bypassing, and much more.

**Discover all the new capabilities in this release — and join our upcoming webinar to see them in
action.**

[Read more →][58]
April 8, 2026
April 7, 2026
[ Newly supported and added appliactions in 9.8 ][59]
April 7, 2026

In version 9.8, we’ve added support for **new apps** and updated **existing ones**. MOBILedit
Forensic now supports over **1,200 applications**, including many local and region-specific apps.
MOBILedit is recognized as the leading tool for application data parsing, helping investigators
extract critical evidence even from niche and regional apps.
Are there local applications you’d like to see supported—public transport, banking, delivery, or
others? Let us know, and we’ll be happy to add them for you!

[Read more →][60]
April 7, 2026
March 4, 2026
[ MOBILedit New Live Updates: Advanced UNISOC & EXYNOS Security Bypassing ][61]
March 4, 2026

**MOBILedit Forensic Live Updates bring new power to users!**
Two new Live Update packages deliver advanced **UNISOC and EXYNOS security bypassing** directly to
users’ investigation workflow. Thanks to Live Updates, critical forensic capabilities are delivered
immediately — without waiting for a new software version. This makes MOBILedit a uniquely responsive
tool, delivering improvements quickly as new challenges emerge.

Read more to explore what’s new in the latest Live Update packages.

# We Specialize in Organic Chemicals

Founded in 1978, Nation Ford Chemical is one of America’s most respected custom and toll
manufacturers of specialty organic chemicals. The company specializes in the production of a variety
of organic intermediates, polymers and colorants for a broad range of customers worldwide.

The team members at Nation Ford Chemical take pride in delivering high quality at a reasonable cost.
For over 45 years, NFC has been known for its ability to outpace other companies by reducing the
lead time necessary to bring new chemicals into production. Our customer-centered approach to toll
manufacturing means we deliver the product you need when you need it.

Chemical production is based at our 28-acre site in Fort Mill, South Carolina, USA, and products are
sold worldwide. In addition to domestic manufacturing, NFC has partnered with strategic suppliers to
efficiently source critical intermediates from around the globe.

Largest Chemical Company in the World Uses Porter Logistics for full 3PL Services: Import, Export,
Distribution, Parcel Fulfillment, and Manufacturing Plant Support

[ Download Fact Sheet + Case Study ][46]

##### The Challenge

One of the largest chemical companies in the world needed full 3PL Warehousing solutions. Their
manufacturing plant produces 100's of SKU's at scale across various Hazard classes and product was
piling up at the end of the production line. Porter needed to warehouse imported materials, supply
the plant with high volume daily shuttles, and then receive finished product across various Hazard
classes. Porter then needed to distribute this product across the United States - fulfilling orders
of drums, pails, IBC's, Bags, and various form factors. We needed to fulfill and distribute to
businesses via FTL, LTL, FCL, & LCL as well as direct to consumer parcel shipments. Porter was also
asked to provide export services to APAC, EMEA, & the Americas.

READ MORE

##### How we Helped

Porter Logistics dove right into the requirements, traveling across the country to observe other
partner
warehouses to understand best practices and specific peculiarities around the client’s products and
processes. After reviewing process, Porter began diving into MSDS requirements – gaining a clear and
complete understanding of Hazard classes, flash points, and unique storage requirements. Porter was
able
to meet the diverse 3PL warehouse needs through a combination of 1) flame room for flammables and
combustibles, 2) heated and cooled rooms for temperature sensitive product, and 3) the processes
necessary to ensure the client stayed compliant with regulatory rules and internal SLA’s. Porter
also exports
Drums, IBC’s, Bags, and other form factors via containers to various customers across the world.

##### Results

The client is thrilled, saying they Porter is by the best 3PL warehouse & logistics provider that
they’ve ever
worked with. Going on three+ years as of 2024, the client is thrilled with our performance. This is
a
permanent partnership and Porter is a critical part of their Global supply chain.

READ LESS [ Download Fact Sheet + Case Study ][47]

### FAQ

## Is Porter Logistics one of the best logistics companies in the US?

Porter Logistics possesses all the qualities of the best logistics companies. Our 3PL warehouse
facilities are fully [certified][48], audited, and secure. Businesses that use Porter for logistics
and storage solutions can feel confident that their inventory is properly handled. 

Porter Logistics is also **quantifiably one of the best 3PL operators based on customer reviews**,
with superior, high average star ratings as rated on Google My Business compared to our
competitors. 

Our [technology integrations][49] give you 24/7 visibility into your inventory because we believe
transparency is key to trust. With flexible engagement models that scale as your business grows and
a suite of value-add services, Porter Logistics is one of the best 3PL companies for businesses
looking to streamline their operations and optimize their supply chain. 

## How much do Porter Logistics’ 3PL services cost?

We’d love to give you a clear cut answer about 3PL pricing, but logistics services just don’t work
like that. 3PL service costs will depend on a variety of factors including:
* Length of Contract
* Type of Commodity (e.g., HAZMAT, food/beverage, pharmaceuticals)
* Value-Added Services (e.g., kitting, repacking, or custom labeling)
* Storage & Handling Volumes
* Seasonality of Your Business
* Product Value and Liability
* Payment Terms (billing and payment schedules)

Get in touch with us for a free custom quote. No obligation.

## How does Porter Logistics compare to competitor 3PLs?

The pool of 3PL companies across the US is deep, but we possess qualities that a lot of other 3PL
providers don’t. Porter’s combination of certifications, value-add services, strict security
measures, and technology puts us a step above competitor 3PLs.

Here are some ways that Porter Logistics stands out from competitors:
* [GMP Food Grade][50], SQF-Certified & Cold Chain Certified (FDA, AIB, and more)
* [HAZMAT][51] & Dangerous Goods Certified (USDOT, EPA, ACD)
* Industry Affiliations & Memberships (IWLA, GCCA, and more)
* Adherence to security best practices (CCTV, restricted access, personnel identification systems,
  and more)
* State-of-the-art technology including a proprietary dock management software
* Direct rail access
* Temperature controlled rooms ([cold storage][52], cooled, and heated) 
* Flame rooms with foam suppression systems

Porter Logistics is also **quantifiably one of the best 3PL operators based on customer reviews**,
with superior, high average star ratings as rated on Google My Business compared to our
competitors. 

Whether you’re partnered with another 3PL and are ready to make the switch to a better 3PL or you’re
searching for a 3PL for the first time, Porter Logistics provides exceptional services for a wide
range of industries.

## How do reviews of Porter Logistics compare to other 3PL providers?

While competitors may lack reviews that give you insight into the quality of their operations, our
reviews regularly praise us for our communication, helpfulness, and speed. Our team is well-equipped
with the knowledge and capabilities to get customers in and out of the yard in a timely manner. Many
of our customers even call out our employees by name, praising them for their professionalism and
efficiency.

Our values shine through in everything we do and we take pride in our work.

## What certifications does Porter Logistics have?

Our certified 3PL operations reflect our unwavering commitment to providing reliable, compliant
services. Here’s a rundown of our certifications and memberships by service category:

[**HAZMAT**][53]
* Alliance for Chemical Distribution (ACD)
* US Department of Transportation
* Environmental Protection Agency (EPA)

[**Food-Grade Warehousing**][54]** & **[**Cold Storage**][55]
* Safe Quality Food certification (SQF), meeting the GFSI (Global Food Safety Initiative) 
* Georgia Department of Agriculture – Food Safety License
* AIB International
* FDA-approved
* cGMP (Current Good Manufacturing Practices)
* GCCA (Global Cold Chain Alliance) member

**Industry Affiliations**
* International Warehouse & Logistics Association (IWLA)
* Council of Supply Chain Management Professionals (CSCMP)
* Southeast Warehouse Association (SWA)
* Alliance for Chemical Distribution
* Atlanta Chamber of Commerce

## What industries does Porter Logistics specialize in?

Our capabilities and expertise empowers us to serve a wide range of manufacturers, retailers,
brands, and direct sellers. Our focus industries include, but are not limited to:
* [HAZMAT/chemical][56] and other regulated goods
* [Food & beverage][57]
* [Consumer/retail products][58]
* [Manufacturing ][59]
* [Construction][60]
* [Pharmaceuticals][61]
* [Nutraceuticals][62]/beauty
* And more

with 200 pallets on hand, Porter Logistics possesses the certifications and work ethic to ensure
that your business receives the support it needs to thrive.

#### Case In Point

Largest Chemical Company in the World Uses Porter Logistics for full 3PL Services: Import, Export,
Distribution, Parcel Fulfillment, and Manufacturing Plant Support

[ Download Fact Sheet + Case Study ][46]

##### The Challenge

One of the largest chemical companies in the world needed full 3PL Warehousing solutions. Their
manufacturing plant produces 100's of SKU's at scale across various Hazard classes and product was
piling up at the end of the production line. Porter needed to warehouse imported materials, supply
the plant with high volume daily shuttles, and then receive finished product across various Hazard
classes. Porter then needed to distribute this product across the United States - fulfilling orders
of drums, pails, IBC's, Bags, and various form factors. We needed to fulfill and distribute to
businesses via FTL, LTL, FCL, & LCL as well as direct to consumer parcel shipments. Porter was also
asked to provide export services to APAC, EMEA, & the Americas.

READ MORE

##### How we Helped

Porter Logistics dove right into the requirements, traveling across the country to observe other
partner
warehouses to understand best practices and specific peculiarities around the client’s products and
processes. After reviewing process, Porter began diving into MSDS requirements – gaining a clear and
complete understanding of Hazard classes, flash points, and unique storage requirements. Porter was
able
to meet the diverse 3PL warehouse needs through a combination of 1) flame room for flammables and
combustibles, 2) heated and cooled rooms for temperature sensitive product, and 3) the processes
necessary to ensure the client stayed compliant with regulatory rules and internal SLA’s. Porter
also exports
Drums, IBC’s, Bags, and other form factors via containers to various customers across the world.

##### Results

The client is thrilled, saying they Porter is by the best 3PL warehouse & logistics provider that
they’ve ever
worked with. Going on three+ years as of 2024, the client is thrilled with our performance. This is
a
permanent partnership and Porter is a critical part of their Global supply chain.

### FAQ

## Is Porter Logistics one of the best logistics companies in the US?

Porter Logistics possesses all the qualities of the best logistics companies. Our 3PL warehouse
facilities are fully [certified][48], audited, and secure. Businesses that use Porter for logistics
and storage solutions can feel confident that their inventory is properly handled. 

Porter Logistics is also **quantifiably one of the best 3PL operators based on customer reviews**,
with superior, high average star ratings as rated on Google My Business compared to our
competitors. 

Our [technology integrations][49] give you 24/7 visibility into your inventory because we believe
transparency is key to trust. With flexible engagement models that scale as your business grows and
a suite of value-add services, Porter Logistics is one of the best 3PL companies for businesses
looking to streamline their operations and optimize their supply chain. 

## How much do Porter Logistics’ 3PL services cost?

We’d love to give you a clear cut answer about 3PL pricing, but logistics services just don’t work
like that. 3PL service costs will depend on a variety of factors including:
* Length of Contract
* Type of Commodity (e.g., HAZMAT, food/beverage, pharmaceuticals)
* Value-Added Services (e.g., kitting, repacking, or custom labeling)
* Storage & Handling Volumes
* Seasonality of Your Business
* Product Value and Liability
* Payment Terms (billing and payment schedules)

Get in touch with us for a free custom quote. No obligation.

## How does Porter Logistics compare to competitor 3PLs?

The pool of 3PL companies across the US is deep, but we possess qualities that a lot of other 3PL
providers don’t. Porter’s combination of certifications, value-add services, strict security
measures, and technology puts us a step above competitor 3PLs.

Here are some ways that Porter Logistics stands out from competitors:
* [GMP Food Grade][50], SQF-Certified & Cold Chain Certified (FDA, AIB, and more)
* [HAZMAT][51] & Dangerous Goods Certified (USDOT, EPA, ACD)
* Industry Affiliations & Memberships (IWLA, GCCA, and more)
* Adherence to security best practices (CCTV, restricted access, personnel identification systems,
  and more)
* State-of-the-art technology including a proprietary dock management software
* Direct rail access
* Temperature controlled rooms ([cold storage][52], cooled, and heated) 
* Flame rooms with foam suppression systems

Porter Logistics is also **quantifiably one of the best 3PL operators based on customer reviews**,
with superior, high average star ratings as rated on Google My Business compared to our
competitors. 

Whether you’re partnered with another 3PL and are ready to make the switch to a better 3PL or you’re
searching for a 3PL for the first time, Porter Logistics provides exceptional services for a wide
range of industries.

## How do reviews of Porter Logistics compare to other 3PL providers?

While competitors may lack reviews that give you insight into the quality of their operations, our
reviews regularly praise us for our communication, helpfulness, and speed. Our team is well-equipped
with the knowledge and capabilities to get customers in and out of the yard in a timely manner. Many
of our customers even call out our employees by name, praising them for their professionalism and
efficiency.

Our values shine through in everything we do and we take pride in our work.

## What certifications does Porter Logistics have?

Our certified 3PL operations reflect our unwavering commitment to providing reliable, compliant
services. Here’s a rundown of our certifications and memberships by service category:

[**HAZMAT**][53]
* Alliance for Chemical Distribution (ACD)

# The Complete Chemical Supply Chain Solution

We understand that a well-managed supply chain is a critical component of our customers’ business.
That is why we are committed to being an extension of that business – seamlessly integrating our
services and expertise within our customers’ operations.

## Safety is at the Core of What We Do

At Quantix, safety is at the core of everything we do. From our specialized equipment to our
rigorously trained team, we are committed to protecting people, products, and the planet every mile
of the journey.

## Partnership Built on Performance

We don’t just deliver chemicals—we deliver confidence. Quantix partners with customers to provide
dependable, compliant, and on-time solutions backed by a powerful national network and deep industry
expertise.

## Innovation That Moves You Forward

Quantix blends cutting-edge technology with proven processes to drive efficiency, visibility, and
growth. Our integrated approach helps customers simplify complex supply chains and unlock long-term
value.

## The Complete Chemical Supply Chain Solution

[[Dry Bulk Logistics]][27]

### [Dry Bulk][28]

Specialized dry bulk trucking for powders, pellets, and granular materials. Our bulk chemical
transportation delivers reliable dry bulk truck services with nationwide coverage.

[Learn More][29]
[White Paper: The Dry Bulk Standard][30]
[[Liquid Bulk Logistics]][31]

### [Liquid Bulk & ISO][32]

Comprehensive liquid bulk transportation and ISO tank shipping for hazardous and non-hazardous
chemicals. Our liquid bulk services provide end-to-end chemical logistics with regulatory
compliance.

[Learn More][33]
[[Distribution Centers and In-Plant logistics]][34]

### [Distribution Center & In-Plant][35]

Integrated chemical warehousing and in-plant logistics from production floor to final delivery. Our
chemical distribution solutions streamline inventory management throughout your facilities.

[Learn More][36]
[[Export, Import and Drayage logistsics]][37]

### [Export, Import, & Drayage][38]

Fully integrated export, import, and chemical drayage for ISO tank shipping, containers, and bulk
trucks. We simplify global chemical logistics with expert handling and coast-to-coast coverage.

[Learn More][39]
[[Sustainable Logistics Solutions]][40]

### [Environmental][41]

Chemical manufacturing environmental services built on sustainable by design principles. Our waste
management supply chain solutions help achieve compliance while supporting sustainability goals.

[Learn More][42]
[[Logistics Managed Solutions]][43]

### [Managed Solutions][44]

Advanced logistics management for high-requirement supply chains. We optimize complex transportation
networks to ensure safety, maintain strict compliance, and drive peak operational performance across
Chemical and Pharmaceutical sectors.

[Learn More][45]

## Advanced Shipment Tracking

Introducing the digital nerve center designed to power the Quantix fleet and deliver real-time
logistics visibility to your supply chain.

Chemical logistics is too complex for manual updates and fragmented data. We’ve built a unified
chemical shipment tracking technology that synchronizes our physical trucking network with your
front office in real-time.

[Learn More][46]

## Become Part of the Quantix Difference

As a driver with Quantix, you’ll be working alongside an elite team of hard-working men and women
who’ve built a reputation for excellence among the multinational firms we serve in the chemical and
plastic industries.

## Quest Liner Bulk Transportation Services – Liquid and Dry Bulk Specialized Carrier

[Contact Us][35]

**Thank you for visiting our website!** Quest Liner is part of The McCoy Group, and is a family
owned bulk transportation company established in 1958. With locations in the Gulf Coast, the
Southeast, the Midwest, and Mexico, we provide bulk transportation services to all of North America.

As freight experts specializing in the transportation of specialty chemicals, food grade hazardous
materials, and kosher certified fleet, we serve the following industries:

• Specialty Chemical
• Pharmaceutical
• Plastics
• Petroleum
• Liquid and Dry Bulk Commodity Chemical Industries

**Along with our sister company, Foodliner, we are proud to be a member of the Transport Topics Top
100 Trucking Companies.**

## Touching the lives of billions daily, delivering value as one of India’s largest
## specialty chemical manufacturers.

Rossari Biotech Limited is one of India's largest specialty chemical manufacturers, delivering
high-performance solutions that touch billions of lives daily. With over four decades of experience,
the company offers 4,300+ products to 3,000+ customers across 65+ countries. Operating seven
manufacturing facilities with 332,000+ MTPA capacity, Rossari Biotech serves diverse industries
including Textiles, Home Personal Care and Performance Chemicals, and Animal Health and Nutrition.
The company leads the market across four core chemistries: surfactants, polymers, silicones, and
enzymes. Committed to sustainability through green chemistry and zero-liquid-discharge facilities,
Rossari Biotech leverages its strong foundation and experienced leadership to shape the future of
specialty chemistry, creating lasting value for stakeholders worldwide.

## Meet the agentic integration company

One platform to integrate AI, data, apps, and services.

### Unify, simplify, amplify

Bring AI, applications and data integration together in a composable, unified, low-code platform
that accelerates automation and AI-led innovation.

### Innovators everywhere

Empower everyone across the enterprise to become an innovator, building and safely deploying
intelligent agents, apps or workflows with AI co-pilot, no-code builders and thousands of
connectors.

### AI with trust and control

Lead your organization into the AI-driven future with an easy-to-use, flexible, secure platform that
unlocks new opportunities at every turn. SnapLogic weaves governance, security, and transparency
into every workflow.

## One agentic integration platform. Four technologies.

One platform, one runtime, one upgrade path. Everything you need to connect, scale, and power your
agentic enterprise.

### Data Integration

#### Seamlessly connect data, everywhere

Break down silos and move data across any system, cloud, or on-premises. With SnapLogic pipelines,
you can integrate, transform, and deliver trusted data at scale. Power your analytics and operations
with data you can rely on.

Automate workflows, connect your apps, and run complex processes fast. Our platform has an intuitive
interface and hundreds of pre-built connectors. You get integration that feels easy, so your team
can focus on results.

[Take a Tour][162]

# Reliable Chemical Distribution Across North America & Europe

Soyventis connects manufacturers and end-users with a broad portfolio of specialty and commodity
chemicals — backed by global logistics, technical expertise, and a commitment to supply chain
reliability.

[Explore Our Products][68][Contact Us][69]

About Soyventis

## Who We Are

Soyventis is a global chemical distribution and supply chain company. In this ever changing world,
global sourcing has taken an entirely new meaning. To source product from anywhere in the world has
become simpler, seamless and effortless.

What are not simple are the dramatic changes that take place in the market place. Geopolitical
Risks, Rapid changes in Supply & Demand, Feedstock Fundamentals are various pieces of the Global
Sourcing Puzzle that we try to simplify.

We truly understand the bridge between “Local” & “Global”.

[Learn More About Us][70]
[Soyventis laboratory and research]

20+

Countries Served

Why Soyventis

## Built for Reliability. Driven by Expertise.

### Global Reach

Operating across North America and Europe, Soyventis delivers chemicals to customers in over 20
countries with reliable logistics and local expertise. Our dual-continent presence means faster
response times and deeper market knowledge wherever you operate.

### Broad Product Portfolio

From specialty solvents to performance additives, our catalog spans hundreds of chemical products
across multiple categories.

### Reliable Supply Chain

Strategic partnerships with leading manufacturers ensure consistent availability, competitive
pricing, and on-time delivery.

### Industry Expertise

Our team of chemical specialists brings decades of experience across coatings, personal care,
agriculture, and industrial applications — providing technical guidance alongside product supply. We
don't just deliver chemicals; we help you find the right solution for your formulation challenges.

Industries We Serve

Soyventis connects manufacturers and end-users with a broad portfolio of specialty and commodity
chemicals — backed by global logistics, technical expertise, and a commitment to supply chain

[Explore Our Products][68][Contact Us][69]

About Soyventis

## Who We Are

Soyventis is a global chemical distribution and supply chain company. In this ever changing world,
global sourcing has taken an entirely new meaning. To source product from anywhere in the world has
become simpler, seamless and effortless.

What are not simple are the dramatic changes that take place in the market place. Geopolitical
Risks, Rapid changes in Supply & Demand, Feedstock Fundamentals are various pieces of the Global
Sourcing Puzzle that we try to simplify.

We truly understand the bridge between “Local” & “Global”.

response times and deeper market knowledge wherever you operate.

From specialty solvents to performance additives, our catalog spans hundreds of chemical products
across multiple categories.

# Touropia Travel

Discover the World
* [Destinations][2]
* [USA][3]
* [Florida][4]
* [Caribbean][5]
* [Europe][6]
* [Mexico][7]
* [Videos][8]

Subscribe for your daily dose of beautiful places you never knew existed 🌎
Subscribe
[[Gallup][Gallup]][9]

## [The Best Way to Experience Native American Culture Might Just Be on Route 66][10]

Here’s a place where the high desert brushes up against history, where ancient traditions and the
legend of Route 66 kind of collide.

[Read More][11]
[[Stone Wings][Stone Wings]][12]

### [Skip that Trip to Mars—This Place in America Looks Just as Surreal][13]

The American Southwest hides places that look more like alien planets than anything you’d expect on
Earth. Out here, time feels frozen in stone.

[Read More][14][[Celebration, Florida][Celebration, Florida]][15]

### [Meet the Florida Town Designed as the Perfect Image of Small-Town America][16]

When you picture a town built from scratch to capture a certain vision of American life, maybe you
see winding streets, inviting front porches, and a community vibe that feels almost too perfect to
be real.

[Read More][17][[Destin Beach][Destin Beach]][18]

### [Skip the Caribbean—This Florida Beach Town Is Every Bit as Stunning][19]

You’ve probably caught a glimpse of those exit signs—the turnoff to one of Florida’s most beloved
beach towns.

[Read More][20][[Albania][Albania]][21]

### [Europe’s Last Truly Undiscovered Country Is Ready to Be Explored][22]

Tucked between rugged mountains and a stretch of turquoise coastline, this country sits quietly,
mostly ignored by travelers.

[Read More][23][][24]

### [Hidden on a Tiny Island in the Mediterranean Is a Forgotten Medieval City][25]

Imagine wandering streets where time’s barely moved in centuries, where honey-colored limestone
walls soak up the Mediterranean sun.

[Read More][26][[John Day Fossil Beds National Monument][John Day Fossil Beds National
Monument]][27]

### [You’d Never Expect to Find a Place Like This in America][28]

Picture yourself in front of hills that look like someone splashed them with watercolors—crimson,
gold, and black streaks wrapping around gentle slopes.

[Read More][29][[Smith Rock State Park][Smith Rock State Park]][30]

### [This State Park Looks Like Utah—But It’s Hundreds of Miles From the Mighty Five][31]

Rising 600 feet above the high desert floor, a canyon carved by an ancient river has turned into one
of America’s most iconic outdoor spots.

[Read More][32][[Sheridan][Sheridan]][33]

### [This Is the Western Town Hollywood Wishes It Could Recreate][34]

Tucked between rolling plains and towering peaks, some small cities manage to hold onto something
you just don’t see much anymore.

[Read More][35][[Dubois][Dubois]][36]

### [Somewhere Between Yellowstone and Jackson Lies a Town That Time Forgot][37]

Tucked away in the far northwest corner of Wyoming, you’ll stumble across a place where the
mountains just shoot up and the wilderness feels like it might never end.

[Read More][38][][39]

### [This Town Has Been Luring New Yorkers North for More Than a Century][40]

Imagine a riverside village where American history and Gothic storytelling meet under big, old
trees. Grand estates perch above the water.

[Read More][41][[New Paltz][New Paltz]][42]

### [One of America’s Oldest Streets Is Hidden in This Charming Hudson Valley Town][43]

Picture a spot where rugged cliffs loom over quiet, historic streets, where you might hike along
mountain ridges in the morning and wander among centuries-old stone houses by afternoon.

[Read More][44][[Lasalle Falls][Lasalle Falls]][45]

### [This State Park’s Waterfall-filled Canyons Feel Almost Impossible in the Midwest][46]

This place stands out—almost defiantly—against the endless prairie that surrounds it, and you really
can’t miss the contrast.

[Read More][47][[Geneva][Geneva]][48]

### [Just Outside Chicago Lies One of the Midwest’s Most Beautiful Downtowns][49]

You’ve probably passed through dozens of small towns along a river, but a few still manage to hold
onto their historic character and keep things genuinely lively.

[Read More][50][[Many Glacier Hotel Seats][Many Glacier Hotel Seats]][51]

### [The Historic Lodge Built to Convince Americans They’d Found the Alps][52]

Imagine rolling out of bed to see glacier-carved peaks mirrored in a glassy alpine lake.

[Read More][53][[Lookout Studio][Lookout Studio]][54]

### [This Century-Old Landmark Comes With One of the Most Spectacular Views on Earth][55]

Perched right on the edge of one of the world’s most jaw-dropping natural wonders, some buildings
just seem to grow straight out of the rock.

[Read More][56]

## [The Best Way to Experience Native American Culture Might Just Be on Route 66][10]

Here’s a place where the high desert brushes up against history, where ancient traditions and the
legend of Route 66 kind of collide.

[Read More][11]
[[Stone Wings][Stone Wings]][12]

### [Skip that Trip to Mars—This Place in America Looks Just as Surreal][13]

The American Southwest hides places that look more like alien planets than anything you’d expect on
Earth. Out here, time feels frozen in stone.

[Read More][14][[Celebration, Florida][Celebration, Florida]][15]

### [Meet the Florida Town Designed as the Perfect Image of Small-Town America][16]

When you picture a town built from scratch to capture a certain vision of American life, maybe you
see winding streets, inviting front porches, and a community vibe that feels almost too perfect to
be real.

[Read More][17][[Destin Beach][Destin Beach]][18]

### [Skip the Caribbean—This Florida Beach Town Is Every Bit as Stunning][19]

You’ve probably caught a glimpse of those exit signs—the turnoff to one of Florida’s most beloved
beach towns.

[Read More][20][[Albania][Albania]][21]

### [Europe’s Last Truly Undiscovered Country Is Ready to Be Explored][22]

Tucked between rugged mountains and a stretch of turquoise coastline, this country sits quietly,
mostly ignored by travelers.

[Read More][23][][24]

### [Hidden on a Tiny Island in the Mediterranean Is a Forgotten Medieval City][25]

Imagine wandering streets where time’s barely moved in centuries, where honey-colored limestone
walls soak up the Mediterranean sun.

[Read More][26][[John Day Fossil Beds National Monument][John Day Fossil Beds National
Monument]][27]

### [You’d Never Expect to Find a Place Like This in America][28]

Picture yourself in front of hills that look like someone splashed them with watercolors—crimson,
gold, and black streaks wrapping around gentle slopes.

[Read More][29][[Smith Rock State Park][Smith Rock State Park]][30]

### [This State Park Looks Like Utah—But It’s Hundreds of Miles From the Mighty Five][31]

Rising 600 feet above the high desert floor, a canyon carved by an ancient river has turned into one
of America’s most iconic outdoor spots.

[Read More][32][[Sheridan][Sheridan]][33]

### [This Is the Western Town Hollywood Wishes It Could Recreate][34]

Tucked between rolling plains and towering peaks, some small cities manage to hold onto something
you just don’t see much anymore.

[Read More][35][[Dubois][Dubois]][36]

### [Somewhere Between Yellowstone and Jackson Lies a Town That Time Forgot][37]

Tucked away in the far northwest corner of Wyoming, you’ll stumble across a place where the
mountains just shoot up and the wilderness feels like it might never end.

[Read More][38][][39]

### [This Town Has Been Luring New Yorkers North for More Than a Century][40]

Imagine a riverside village where American history and Gothic storytelling meet under big, old
trees. Grand estates perch above the water.

[Read More][41][[New Paltz][New Paltz]][42]

### [One of America’s Oldest Streets Is Hidden in This Charming Hudson Valley Town][43]

Picture a spot where rugged cliffs loom over quiet, historic streets, where you might hike along
mountain ridges in the morning and wander among centuries-old stone houses by afternoon.

[Read More][44][[Lasalle Falls][Lasalle Falls]][45]

### [This State Park’s Waterfall-filled Canyons Feel Almost Impossible in the Midwest][46]

This place stands out—almost defiantly—against the endless prairie that surrounds it, and you really
can’t miss the contrast.

[Read More][47][[Geneva][Geneva]][48]

### [Just Outside Chicago Lies One of the Midwest’s Most Beautiful Downtowns][49]

You’ve probably passed through dozens of small towns along a river, but a few still manage to hold
onto their historic character and keep things genuinely lively.

[Read More][50][[Many Glacier Hotel Seats][Many Glacier Hotel Seats]][51]

### [The Historic Lodge Built to Convince Americans They’d Found the Alps][52]

Imagine rolling out of bed to see glacier-carved peaks mirrored in a glassy alpine lake.

[Read More][53][[Lookout Studio][Lookout Studio]][54]

### [This Century-Old Landmark Comes With One of the Most Spectacular Views on Earth][55]

Perched right on the edge of one of the world’s most jaw-dropping natural wonders, some buildings
just seem to grow straight out of the rock.

stay coordinated across the shipment lifecycle.

[Drayage icon]

accumulated data informing routing and capacity decisions. Predictive signals keep the network
